system.description: The character does not require vision because she possesses another sense of equal discrimination — a bat's sonar, a bloodhound's sense of smell, and so forth. She suffers no penalty from operating in total darkness (though purely visual tasks, such as reading, remain impossible) and can identify others by non-visual means. Alternate Senses tend to "see through" Obfuscate and Chimerstry, since few Cainites understand nonhuman or superhuman senses: when a character with this Merit encounters a user of Chimerstry, Obfuscate, or a similar power, treat the concealing character's effective Auspex rating as two dots higher than it actually is (or as rating 2 if she has none) for purposes of resisting perception. Alternate Senses often accompany Auspex or one of the body-altering Disciplines (Protean, Serpentis, Vicissitude), and usually occur only in Cainites who suffer blindness or another extreme sensory impairment.
system.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Five: Storytelling (Unique Abilities)
